system_overview: This module provides a library of theorems about sequences and the corresponding operations such as concatenation, append, head, tail, subsequence, and length. It is part of the standard proof library used by the TLA Proof System (TLAPS). The theorems cover elementary properties of sequences, membership, equality, and the behavior of standard sequence operators.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or concurrent components. This is a purely mathematical module providing lemmas and theorems about finite sequences.
additional_assumptions: This is a helper module from the standard proof library. It extends the Sequences, Integers, WellFoundedInduction, Functions, and TLAPS modules. It defines no behavior or temporal properties.
